title: Ribbed Off-Shoulder Zip Top & Heart Belt
prompt: An original young woman with long, wavy dark hair wears a dusty blue ribbed off-shoulder top with a center zip and a flared sleeve cuff. A bold silver heart-shaped belt buckle sits over washed-out dark jeans. Long drop earrings and a sleek choker complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even studio light against a pale gray backdrop. Palette of dusty blue, washed denim, and silver. Relaxed and cool, in the style of a fashion-forward street-style lookbook.
workingNotes:
- The off-shoulder zip top and heart buckle are the defining details.
- Keep the washed denim for a relaxed, lived-in look.
